question: Among surface coating materials for high-energy lithium-ion cathodes, which has the highest Li-ion diffusivity listed?
rendered:
Document: Valuation of Surface Coatings in High-Energy Density Lithium-ion Battery Cathode Materials

Table 5. Table 5 Lithium-ion diffusivity of different coating materials at 300K.

The coating material with the highest Li-ion diffusivity listed is Li0.6TiO2 with a diffusivity of 1.3 ×10^− 11 cm^2/s.
